scope: ECCV 2014/2016 main proceedings title scan via Crossref container-title results; direct-HSI titles included, multispectral/bispectral/general spectral titles excluded. One DOI version per included paper; no code access.

method.query: Crossref query.container-title=Computer Vision ECCV YEAR, type=book-chapter, rows=1000; title keyword filter; Crossref DOI metadata, Semantic Scholar bibliography/openAccessPdf, OpenAlex locations; Springer PDF URL fetch attempted once per included DOI.
method.limitations: Crossref result set is ranked and not a formal complete chapter enumeration; title scan is a gap-finding pass, not proof of annual closure. Springer pages did not expose readable PDFs in this environment.
